title: The framework and third-party Joomla quickstarts of batch 4 have the slot contracts their measurement allows: Purity III, T3 Blank and T4 Blank (t4-framework + ijoomla-com-guru-pro) are ready, the five GavickPro templates have no slot; a template sized by Bootstrap utilities takes sizes and shapes !important, and a kept light band keeps its own text
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/cms.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-door.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'Joomla: a template sized by Bootstrap utilities takes sizes and shapes !important, a JA template does not' passes.

'a template maps to its slot contract; one without a contract says why' passes (purity_III, t3_bs3_blank, t4_bs5_blank map to their contracts; gk_appetit, gk_archi, gk_compact, gk_restly, gk_spotlight answer TEMPLATE_HAS_NO_SLOT).
fence: Which Joomla template element maps to which slot contract and readiness; the opt-in emitter rules a Bootstrap-utility page needs. No stand, no model, no Docker.

tests: Joomla: a template sized by Bootstrap utilities takes sizes and shapes !important, a JA template does not
a template maps to its slot contract; one without a contract says why
